lineage.v1_attempt_status: the first fixed-source invocation aborted during its first permutation-integrity check; it emitted no aggregate result, null distribution, decision reference, p-value, GO, or NO_GO
lineage.metric_visibility: the V1 call computed observed and baseline metrics before the abort but emitted none; no metric value was inspected or used to choose this correction
lineage.supersession_reason: V1 compared mathematically exact family-weighted mass through order-dependent binary-float accumulation and falsely rejected a valid permutation; its repeated-addition model and metric accumulators could also violate the declared exact-replica weighting at floating-point ties. V2 validates the invariant with exact rational arithmetic before any metric calculation and uses order-stable math.fsum bucket accumulation
unchanged_contracts: split seed, fraction, families, and clustering
degradation seed, domains, rates, nesting, and replicas
model features, smoothing, tie-break, and row weights
permutation seed schedule, hash domain, donor assignment, and run count
support gates, metrics, decision references, and thresholds

implementation.numeric_runtime_binding: required in every report; exact JSON byte identity is claimed only within the same reported runtime
implementation.pre_result_code_commit: required caller-declared 40-character lowercase Git commit in every real-source report; the evaluator does not infer or independently attest Git state, publication time, custody, or blindness
implementation.integrity_preflight: all 999 scheduled training-label assignments and their structural, raw-count, exact-family-mass, and replica-consistency invariants are validated before observed, baseline, permutation-null, or decision metrics are calculated

scientific_scope.positive_scope: Recovery of four MTAAC word-level gold categories from opaque ATF FORM tokens and local line structure.
scientific_scope.freeze_limit: A public source commit before the first real score is a pre-result code freeze, not independent preregistration, blindness, custody, or trusted time.

source.selected_manifest_digest_contract: SHA-256 begins with b'indusbench:mtaac:selected-manifest:v1\x00'; for each selected canonical morph/to_dict path in ascending ASCII order append the UTF-8 path prefixed by its unsigned-8-byte big-endian length, the source byte length as unsigned 8-byte big-endian, and the raw 32-byte SHA-256 digest of the source bytes; report with sha256: prefix
source.evaluation_corpus_digest_contract: SHA-256 begins with b'indusbench:mtaac:evaluation-corpus:v1\x00', then the admitted-document count as unsigned 8-byte big-endian; for each admitted document in ascending P identifier order append framed P identifier and anonymous line count; for each anonymous line append zero-based line ordinal and token count; for every token in source order append zero-based within-line source order, framed exact FORM, framed projected class or context_only, and one byte 0x00 for context-only rows or a declared placeholder diagnostic stem, otherwise 0x01 followed by the framed casefolded SEGM prefix before the first [ character; counts and ordinals are unsigned 8-byte big-endian and every framed string is exact UTF-8 prefixed by its unsigned-8-byte big-endian length; raw token-ID spelling, container formatting, and unused annotations are excluded because only their derived anonymous grouping/order can affect V1
source.evaluation_equivalence_gate: the synthetic entry rejects this digest even when container formatting or ignored annotation columns change; the real entry requires it before split or scoring

parser.line_endings: LF or CRLF accepted; lone CR rejected
parser.revision_attestation: the caller must supply bytes matching the fixed archive SHA-256 and selected-member manifest; this binds the evaluated bytes to the downloaded archive but does not prove GitHub custody, retrieval time, or independent witnessing

gold_projection.segm_stem_diagnostic: take exact SEGM substring before the first [ character and apply Unicode casefold with no other normalization; this is a raw string bucket, not a lemma
gold_projection.gold_class_use: training target for train rows and evaluator-side truth for test rows; never a prediction feature
gold_projection.derived_structure_allowed: line membership and row order may be derived evaluator-side from raw token ID, then exposed only as anonymous relative structure
gold_projection.target_eligibility: every strict token matched by exactly one mechanical class rule
gold_projection.source_placeholder_policy: diagnostic stem values exactly equal after casefold to empty string, _, _(_), x, n, ..., or … remain fully eligible primary targets but are omitted from seen/unseen SEGM-stem diagnostics; no philological repair or source-readability exclusion
gold_projection.coverage_denominator: all strictly admitted mechanically projected target tokens in the applicable pre-degradation stratum
gold_projection.semantic_nonorthogonality: row labels are mutually exclusive at this pin, but some unit FORM values jointly encode magnitude and unit; independent semantic quantity/unit decomposition is not claimed

observation.opaque_form_id: mtaac-word-form-sha256-v1: plus lowercase SHA-256 of b'indusbench:mtaac:word-form:v1\x00' followed by exact UTF-8 FORM bytes
observation.opaque_document_key: mtaac-document-source-id-sha256-v1: plus lowercase SHA-256 of b'indusbench:mtaac:document-source-id:v1\x00' followed by the exact ASCII P identifier; evaluator-only family/event/null identity and never a prediction feature or report value
observation.opaque_token_key: mtaac-token-source-order-sha256-v1: plus lowercase SHA-256 of b'indusbench:mtaac:token-source-order:v1\x00', the opaque document key as framed ASCII bytes, and zero-based visual source order as unsigned 8-byte big-endian; evaluator-only alignment identity and never a prediction feature or report value
observation.identity_gold_independence: document and token keys must remain identical when SEGM, XPOSTAG, HEAD, DEPREL, or MISC changes without changing P identifier or source row order; key collisions are hard failures
observation.opacity_limit: categorical coding only; not secrecy, blindness, or independence from the public ATF transliteration
observation.line_key: raw ID without its final dot component; IDs without a dot become row-ordinal unlocated singleton lines

diagnostic_cue_ablations.ascii_digit_mask: replace each ASCII [0-9] code point in raw FORM with # before opaque hashing; this retains digit count and surrounding notation and is not called removal of every numeric cue
diagnostic_cue_ablations.determinative_mask: replace each left-to-right non-nested span matching \{[^{}]*\} in raw FORM with {DET} before opaque hashing
diagnostic_cue_ablations.evaluation_scope: full model on the mild novel_exact_line_sequence primary stratum with the already fixed split, degradation events, weights, and truth
diagnostic_cue_ablations.masked_collision_policy: intentional categorical collapse is allowed and reported separately from a primary opaque-ID collision
diagnostic_cue_ablations.role: diagnostic only; no cue-ablation result changes support status, thresholds, the primary decision reference, or overall GO

split.tuple_framing: each nonnegative integer is unsigned 8-byte big-endian; each byte string is prefixed by its unsigned 8-byte big-endian length
split.cluster_identifier: lowercase 64-hex SHA-256 of cluster_hash_domain, framed token count, then each ordered exact complete-document opaque FORM ID as framed ASCII bytes
split.algorithm: rank clusters by raw SHA-256 digest of hash_domain, unsigned-8-byte seed, then the lowercase cluster identifier as framed ASCII bytes; break a digest tie by cluster identifier ASCII order; assign the lowest test_count clusters to test
split.primary_test_stratum: test lines whose tuple of every source-row exact pre-degradation opaque FORM ID in source order is not equal to any complete train-line tuple; determine membership once before windowing, reversal, variants, damage, and replicas
split.diagnostic_strata_contract: fix membership after the source-document split and before degradation; seen word FORM means the target's exact opaque FORM ID occurs among readable labeled train target rows without conditioning on class; after omitting declared placeholder stems, seen SEGM stem means the evaluator-side raw diagnostic stem occurs among labeled train target stems without conditioning on class; V1 reports membership target/family counts and support adequacy only and defines no stratum-specific score

degradation.line_grouping: scan source rows in source order; an ID with a non-empty prefix before its final dot uses that prefix as evaluator-only line key, otherwise it forms a unique row-ordinal singleton; a line key recurring after another line has begun is a hard failure; expose only zero-based anonymous line and within-line order
degradation.event_tuple_framing: hash the named domain bytes, unsigned-8-byte seed, framed ASCII bytes of the opaque document identity, then unsigned-8-byte zero-based anonymous line ordinal and, for per-occurrence events only, unsigned-8-byte zero-based source-order within-line index
degradation.event_uniform: interpret the first 8 SHA-256 digest bytes as an unsigned big-endian integer and divide by 2^64
degradation.rate_event: event occurs exactly when event_uniform < configured rate

event_keys.window_anchor: one token event key for every source token; select the lexicographically smallest full digest, breaking a digest tie by lower source-order within-line index
event_keys.reverse: line event key without token index
event_keys.direction_unknown: line event key without token index
event_keys.pseudo_surface_variant_id: token event key followed by the base opaque FORM ID as framed ASCII bytes
event_keys.duplicate: document event key containing only domain, seed, and framed opaque document_key

degradation.window_contract: for source line length n and non-null maximum m, let L=min(m,n), let a be the zero-based hash-ranked anchor index, set left=min(max(a-floor((L-1)/2),0),n-L), and retain source-order half-open window [left,left+L); null maximum retains the full line
degradation.nested_event_contract: all regimes use the same seed and event hashes; the shorter harsh window is a subset of the mild window, and every mild rate event is a harsh event whenever the harsh rate is greater; verify these properties before scoring
degradation.visual_order_contract: reverse the retained source-order line exactly when its reverse event occurs; direction-known and direction-unknown events are evaluated independently of reversal
degradation.known_direction_contract: when direction is reported known, restore retained source reading order before position and neighbor features; when unknown, use retained visual order; reported_direction is known_source_order or unknown_visual_order
degradation.pseudo_variant_id: when the event occurs, replace the base opaque FORM ID with mtaac-artificial-word-form-sha256-v1: plus the lowercase full SHA-256 digest from pseudo_surface_variant_id; one affected source occurrence has one artificial ID shared by all its replicas and remains readable; this does not reveal or assert a natural allographic relationship
degradation.damage_contract: a damage event replaces that retained occurrence's observed FORM ID with null; it has no prediction row or readable target, but an adjacent readable prediction row sees the categorical neighbor value DAMAGED
degradation.replica_contract: after all other events, a duplicate event creates exactly one extra exact replica of the complete degraded source document; otherwise there is one representative; replicas never cross partitions and receive no new pseudo-variant or damage event

model.prediction_row: one retained occurrence whose observed FORM ID is non-null and whose evaluator-side gold projection has exactly one class
model.readable_target: a retained mechanically projected target occurrence with non-null observed FORM ID
model.train_labels: gold labels of readable train-side prediction rows only
model.test_labels: evaluator-side truth of readable test prediction rows only
model.train_weighting: for a source-document family with R readable target source occurrences and D replicas, every corresponding prediction row has weight 1/(R*D); a family with R=0 supplies no model row or effective support
model.test_weighting: for a source-document family with R readable target source occurrences in the predeclared primary test stratum and D replicas, every corresponding scored row has weight 1/(R*D); a family with R=0 supplies no metric row or effective support
model.duplicate_weighting: the exact formulas above divide one total family unit across deterministic exact replicas
model.weighted_accumulation: within each class, feature-value, majority, and confusion-matrix bucket, collect the declared binary-float row weights and reduce them with Python math.fsum rather than order-dependent repeated addition; because V2 admits only D=1 or D=2 and division by two is exact for these normal binary floats, an exact duplicate pair contributes the same bucket mass as its representative
model.anchor_free_behavior: return not_identifiable and emit no F1, null distribution, p-value, decision reference, or GO/NO_GO decision
model.feature_structure_contract: compute position and line length over every retained occurrence including damaged and context-only rows in the model order; previous and next are the immediate retained neighbors, using BOS/EOS at a boundary and DAMAGED for a null observed FORM ID

smoothing.V_feature: number of distinct train values for that feature plus one reserved unseen bucket
smoothing.score: sum natural logarithm of the smoothed class prior and all declared feature likelihoods

model.unknown_value: one reserved UNSEEN categorical bucket per feature name; a test value absent from that feature's train vocabulary maps to it and its train mass is zero
model.tie_break: select the first exact maximum in fixed class order quantity, unit, person_name, settlement_name

majority_class.contract: choose the class with greatest weighted train class mass and use the fixed class order for an exact tie

position_and_line_structure_only.contract: use the same Naive Bayes, train weights, test weights, regime, and primary stratum as the full model; opaque FORM and neighbor identities are excluded

opaque_FORM_lexicon_only.contract: diagnostic only; use the same Naive Bayes, train weights, test weights, regime, and primary stratum as the full model

permutation_null.scope: training labels only; test truth and observations never permuted
permutation_null.representative_and_replicas: build one label vector per source-document family from its representative degraded document and apply the assigned vector identically to all exact replicas
permutation_null.vector_order: zero-based anonymous line order, then the prediction rows' zero-based retained model order, restricted to readable train target occurrences
permutation_null.permutation_algorithm: within each readable-target-count stratum, sort recipient families by opaque document_key ASCII; independently rank donor families by raw SHA-256 of permutation_hash_domain, unsigned-8-byte run seed, unsigned-8-byte readable-target-count value R naming the stratum, and framed opaque document_key ASCII bytes, breaking a digest tie by document_key; assign the ranked donor vectors in order to the canonical recipient order
permutation_null.movable_family_weight_fraction: number of readable eligible train source-document families in strata containing at least two families divided by all readable eligible train source-document families; every family has one unit of weight
permutation_null.family_mass_invariant_arithmetic: derive each row's exact rational protocol weight 1/(R*D) from structural readable-target count R and contiguous replica count D; require the stored binary-float row weight to equal float(1/(R*D)); compare original and assigned per-class sums as exact rational numbers, and require every replica to receive the representative assigned vector
permutation_null.pre_metric_schedule_validation: materialize and validate the assignments for all 999 distinct scheduled seeds before calculating any observed, baseline, null, or decision metric; use those exact validated assignments for the null runs without regeneration
permutation_null.run_validity: exactly 999 distinct scheduled seeds and 999 finite macro-F1 values are required; any missing seed, duplicate seed, NaN, or infinite value is an integrity error before p95 or p-value
permutation_null.p95_method: sort all 999 required finite run macro-F1 values ascending; h=(runs-1)*0.95; linearly interpolate between zero-based floor(h) and ceil(h)
permutation_null.p_value: (1 + number of permutation macro-F1 values greater than or equal to observed macro-F1) / (runs + 1)

references.decision_reference: separately for clean and mild, use that regime's train observations and the identical novel_exact_line_sequence test truth/weighting; take the maximum of majority macro-F1, position-only macro-F1, and that regime's permutation-null p95 macro-F1; the mild add-one p-value alone is inferentially decision-bearing

metrics.primary: source-document-family-weighted four-class macro-F1 on mild novel-line test targets
metrics.weighted_metric_contract: derive precision, recall, F1, balanced accuracy, accuracy, and confusion entries from the exact nonnegative test row weights; macro-F1 is the arithmetic mean of the four class F1 values and balanced accuracy is the arithmetic mean of the four recalls
metrics.zero_denominator_contract: precision is 0 when predicted mass is zero; recall is unavailable when truth mass is zero; F1 is 0 when precision plus recall is zero; a decision-bearing aggregate is unavailable unless every class has positive truth support and passes the declared family gates; diagnostic membership buckets report counts and support adequacy only and have no V1 aggregate metric
metrics.coverage: for each class and test source-document family having at least one eligible target in a pre-degradation full line belonging to novel_exact_line_sequence, divide the count retained with non-null observed FORM ID by that pre-degradation eligible count; report the arithmetic mean across those families for each class; replicas do not alter numerator or denominator
metrics.coverage_decision_scope: test primary stratum only; train coverage may be reported only as a diagnostic
metrics.effective_family_definition: for a class and partition/regime/stratum, the number of distinct source-document families with at least one readable prediction or scored source occurrence of that class before replica expansion

reporting.deterministic: for fixed exact archive bytes, exact protocol bytes, implementation, caller-declared pre-result code commit, and the same reported numeric runtime, emit the same UTF-8 JSON value with no wall-clock field
reporting.numeric_runtime: report Python implementation/version, operating-system family, machine architecture, libc name/version when available, and binary-float mantissa width; do not report a host or account identifier
reporting.cross_runtime_byte_identity: not claimed because categorical Naive Bayes uses binary floating point and the platform math library; threshold comparisons use exact computed values with no post-hoc tolerance
public_aggregate_allowlist: protocol/source/code commitments and public source citation
parser stage and reason-code aggregate counts
aggregate weighted metrics, confusion matrices, coverage, ablations, null summaries, and per-run seed/macro-F1/fixed-point counts
explicit scientific nonclaims and terminal status
forbidden_report_values: raw FORM, SEGM, XPOSTAG, HEAD, DEPREL, MISC, or token ID
P identifier, corpus member path, local path, host, account, or storage topology
opaque document_key, token_key, per-document prediction, or per-document metric
retrieval timestamp, trusted-time claim, custody claim, blindness claim, independent preregistration claim, or Indus decipherment claim
reporting.quarantine_reporting: reason-code aggregate counts only; no document identifier or path

decision.threshold_provenance: project defaults selected before the first real score; not externally preregistered
decision.decision_bearing_support: mild train and mild novel_exact_line_sequence test effective-family minima for every class, plus positive clean and mild primary-stratum truth support and defined clean/mild coverage for every class
decision.overall_GO: all parser, source, protocol, support, integrity, and leakage gates pass; clean requirements pass; and mild requirements pass. Harsh and cue-ablation diagnostics cannot change overall GO.
decision.clean_primary_stratum: the same novel_exact_line_sequence test stratum used by mild
decision.insufficient_support_behavior: emit insufficient_evidence and no four-class aggregate, decision reference, p-value, GO, or NO_GO metric; do not search another seed, alter a domain, lower a threshold, or merge classes after seeing support
status_precedence: invalid source bytes, manifest, parser stage, protocol digest, implementation constant, integrity, or leakage invariant -> error with no scientific metric report
anchor-free execution -> not_identifiable with no F1, null, or decision metric
decision-bearing primary support failure -> insufficient_evidence with no four-class aggregate
support passes but any clean or mild threshold fails -> no_go
all parser, source, protocol, support, integrity, leakage, clean, and mild requirements pass -> go
